method: Exact opaque player sprite template matching against supplied Mario left/right sheets on controller-protocol PNGs. Origin preserves 32px sheet cell. Coordinates in screen pixels, y down. Frames are response frames_advanced sums, not assumed ticks*8.
source: Independent fresh reset per experiment via authorized run-model.sh input protocol only.

observed.classification: observed from controller responses and exact supplied-sprite matches
observed.note: Held A does not jump again after landing. Neutral 30 native frames before each stable experiment leaves identical movement and vertical curves shifted by 30 frames. All player template matches returned confidence=1; subpixel coordinates remain unobservable.

horizontal.uncertainty: Initial subpixel x and exact fractional update order are not uniquely identifiable from 7/8-frame image samples. Simple acceleration model fits first checkpoints within about 1–2px; do not claim exact constants.

standingJump.model: y += velocity; velocity += gravity, capped on descent. Effective latency is fitted to protocol-visible output, not claimed as controller hardware latency.

releasedStandingJump.model: y += velocity; velocity += gravity, capped on descent. Effective latency is fitted to protocol-visible output, not claimed as controller hardware latency.

camera.rule: While player screen x is between 80 and 112, camera increments approximately ceil(integer player world displacement/2) per native frame. At 112 camera follows full displacement. Camera does not reverse.
camera.uncertainty: No per-native-frame screenshot API exists; rule inferred from multiple 7/8-frame deltas, not uniquely proven.

unresolved: Exact subpixel arithmetic, action latency and native simulation update order.
Jump velocity/force selection thresholds across all initial horizontal speeds.
Exact reversal braking acceleration, air control and airborne friction.
Swimming, springboard, enemy bounce and big-player collision geometry; not measured in these World 1-1 opening experiments.
Sprite clipping during partial offscreen movement; template search requires complete 16x32 cell inside frame.
Reference image protocol has no audio stream; no audio equivalence is claimed.

horizontalCandidateFits.classification: inferred; finite image samples admit multiple zero-error models
